guard: Host-owned managed-agent enrollment and terminal-release preparation are authorized only for a caller holding supervise at its own instance's current open manager gate, with the host-issued registration proof, the host-selected lifecycle UID, and the one derived terminal operation id; stock dispatch sends each kind to its own host arm rather than to a manager-lifecycle phase
why: The two space mutations accept a request that names another host space. A participant registered on one mesh could then have an agent enrolled, or released, in a mesh it never joined; the suite names the cell that refuses a foreign space for each operation.

The two supervise mutations accept spawn or admin in place of supervise. Those are ordinary agent capabilities that a great many rows carry, so this is the single widest escalation available here, and the suite proves each operation refuses a fully spawn/admin-scoped row.

The gate-state mutation accepts any gate the KV happens to hold, including a frozen one. A frozen gate is a takeover in flight, so an enrollment admitted there would author a grant against a registration that is being replaced; the suite runs a real frozen gate row and an absent one.

The gate-principal mutation accepts a gate whose serving principal belongs to a different owner's serve actor. That is the cross-tenant hole: one owner's manager would drive another owner's registration. The suite writes exactly that row on the real broker.

The epoch mutation accepts a stale serveEpoch. A superseded manager process could then keep enrolling and releasing after its successor took the gate; the suite names the conflict cell for each operation.

The proof mutation drops the constant-time proof comparison. The registration proof is the only host-issued fact in the request, so without it every other coordinate is participant-supplied; the suite presents a forged proof, a proof for a superseded registration revision, and a proof derived under another owner.

Those four mutations edit the one current-registration check every door in the module runs, and each is named against an enrollment cell. The prepare-retirement mutation skips that check at the release door alone, so the suite proves the release door reaches it rather than relying on the enrollment cells.
The target-owner mutation lets a prepare-retirement name another owner's target. It would let one participant start the terminal release of a foreign agent; the suite names that cell.

The opId mutation trusts the caller's opId instead of recomputing managedRetirementOpId(target.lifecycleUid). Two opIds for one lifecycle means two barriers over one head, which is the hazard the derivation exists to remove.

The tokenHash mutation lets the closed parser accept any string where the sha256 digest belongs, so a plaintext standing actor token would pass as a digest and land on the host and in its logs. The suite feeds it a real actorToken and names the refusal.

The lifecycle-uid mutation lets the enrollment parser retain a caller-supplied lifecycleUid. Only the host can see the retirement tombstones that make a UID permanently unusable, so a participant-named UID could aim a fresh grant at a dead incarnation.

The dispatch mutation drops the enrollment branch, so a managed-agent request falls through to the manager-lifecycle issuer. The suite names the routing cell, and its negative control proves an ordinary manager-authority request still reaches its own arm.

mutations.name: enrollment accepts a request naming another host space
mutations.find:
if (r.space !== args.space)
    throw new EpEnvelopeError("permission-denied", `enrollment request names space ${r.space}, not host space ${args.space}`);
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: enrollment: a request naming another host space is refused
mutations.cell: enrollment: a request naming another host space is refused

mutations.name: enrollment accepts spawn/admin in place of supervise
mutations.find:
if (!args.scope.includes("supervise"))
    throw new EpEnvelopeError("permission-denied", 'managed agent enrollment needs scope "supervise"; spawn/admin do not imply it');
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: a row without "supervise" is refused even holding spawn and admin
mutations.cell: a row without "supervise" is refused even holding spawn and admin

mutations.name: the current-registration check accepts any manager gate state, including frozen
mutations.find:
if (!gate || gate.state !== "open")
    throw new EpEnvelopeError("failed-precondition", `${what} found no current open manager gate for instance ${r.instanceId}`);
mutations.replace: if (!gate) throw new EpEnvelopeError("failed-precondition", `${what} found no current open manager gate for instance ${r.instanceId}`);
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: enrollment: a FROZEN gate is refused (a takeover in flight is not a registration)
mutations.cell: enrollment: a FROZEN gate is refused (a takeover in flight is not a registration)

mutations.name: the current-registration check accepts a gate held by another owner's serve principal
mutations.find:
if (gate.principal !== servePrincipal)
    throw new EpEnvelopeError("permission-denied", `manager gate belongs to ${gate.principal}, not serve principal ${servePrincipal}`);
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: enrollment: a gate held by another owner's serve principal is refused
mutations.cell: enrollment: a gate held by another owner's serve principal is refused

mutations.name: the current-registration check accepts a stale serve epoch
mutations.find:
if (gate.processEpoch !== r.serveEpoch)
    throw new EpEnvelopeError("conflict", `manager serve epoch ${r.serveEpoch} is stale; current is ${gate.processEpoch}`);
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: enrollment: a stale serve epoch is refused as a conflict
mutations.cell: enrollment: a stale serve epoch is refused as a conflict

mutations.name: the current-registration check stops checking the host-issued registration proof
mutations.find:
if (!timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(r.registrationProof), Buffer.from(expectedProof)))
    throw new EpEnvelopeError("permission-denied", `manager ${what} proof does not match current host registration`);
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: enrollment: a forged registration proof is refused
mutations.cell: enrollment: a forged registration proof is refused

mutations.name: prepare-retirement accepts a request naming another host space
mutations.find:
if (r.space !== args.space)
    throw new EpEnvelopeError("permission-denied", `prepare-retirement request names space ${r.space}, not host space ${args.space}`);
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: release: a request naming another host space is refused
mutations.cell: release: a request naming another host space is refused

mutations.name: prepare-retirement accepts spawn/admin in place of supervise
mutations.find:
if (!args.scope.includes("supervise"))
    throw new EpEnvelopeError("permission-denied", 'managed agent prepare-retirement needs scope "supervise"; spawn/admin do not imply it');

mutations.name: prepare-retirement accepts a foreign target owner
mutations.find:
if (r.target.owner !== args.owner)
    throw new EpEnvelopeError("permission-denied", `prepare-retirement target owner "${r.target.owner}" does not match authenticated owner "${args.owner}"`);
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: release: a target owner that is not the authenticated owner is refused
mutations.cell: release: a target owner that is not the authenticated owner is refused

mutations.name: prepare-retirement trusts the caller's opId instead of recomputing it
mutations.find:
if (o.opId !== managedRetirementOpId(parsedTarget.lifecycleUid))
    enrollmentError(what, `opId must be the derived terminal operation id for lifecycle ${parsedTarget.lifecycleUid}`);
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: prepare-retirement refuses a second valid opId for one lifecycle
mutations.cell: prepare-retirement refuses a second valid opId for one lifecycle

mutations.name: prepare-retirement skips the current-registration check
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: release: a forged registration proof is refused
mutations.cell: release: a forged registration proof is refused

mutations.name: the closed parser accepts any string where the token digest belongs
mutations.find:
if (typeof t.tokenHash !== "string" || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(t.tokenHash))
    enrollmentError(what, "target.tokenHash must be a lowercase hex sha256 digest of the locally held actorToken");
mutations.replace:
if (typeof t.tokenHash !== "string" || t.tokenHash.length === 0)
    enrollmentError(what, "target.tokenHash must be a lowercase hex sha256 digest of the locally held actorToken");
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: enrollment refuses a non-digest tokenHash (a plaintext token never passes as one)
mutations.cell: enrollment refuses a non-digest tokenHash (a plaintext token never passes as one)

mutations.name: the closed parser lets an enrollment carry a caller-chosen lifecycle uid
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: enrollment refuses an unknown top-level field
mutations.cell: enrollment refuses an unknown top-level field

mutations.name: stock dispatch sends an enrollment request to the manager-lifecycle issuer
mutations.find:
if (request.kind === "manager-managed-agent-enrollment")
    return ctx.enrollManagedAgent({ owner, scope: row.scope ?? [], request: body.request as RemoteManagedAgentEnrollmentRequest });
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: dispatch sends an enrollment request to the host enrollment arm with the caller's ledger scope
mutations.cell: dispatch sends an enrollment request to the host enrollment arm with the caller's ledger scope
